audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Urgot every single row including 2+ items, while whys[0] says Level 1 is even, whys[6] says Kayle 'flips the matchup hard' late, and the packet levelChart reads Skill / Urgot x5 / Kayle.
audit.why: Kayle is melee with no waveclear until her Divine Ascent range spike, so Urgot owns levels 2-6; past two items her ranged DPS and Divine Judgment's untargetability invert the duel. The page currently renders a level-1 and a two-item Urgot win that its own prose denies.
audit.corrected: Level 1 -> Skill (rating 5/10) and 2+ items -> Kayle (rating 3/10), both as matched full+content pairs, with phases[6].why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] attributes Kayle's level-6 ranged attacks to 'Starfire Spellblade zaps'. The range comes from her passive, Divine Ascent.
audit.why: Starfire Spellblade (E) is an auto-attack reset dealing missing-health bonus damage at 550 range; it is not the source of her ranged form. Naming the wrong ability means the player watches the wrong spike.
audit.corrected: Rewrote the level-6 spike around Divine Ascent (P) for the range and Divine Judgment's 160s rank-1 cooldown as the real window.
sources: enemyKit P text: 'progressively gains Attack Speed, Move Speed, Attack Range'

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says to 'track Divine Judgment' everywhere without ever stating the two interactions that matter: it makes the target untargetable, which eats your Fear Beyond Death outright, and it is 160s at rank 1.
audit.why: Urgot's R is a 100s ultimate whose whole value is the execute threshold. Firing it into an invulnerability window burns both. Conversely, once she has spent it there is a two-and-a-half minute hole. Also missing: Celestial Blessing is a flat 15s heal, so Grievous Wounds decides extended trades, and Starfire Spellblade's auto reset is the wind-up tell to step back on.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d rewritten with the untargetability, the 160s number, the 15s heal and the E wind-up tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t says the Executioner's Calling 'cuts his healing' and Doran's Shield is 'vs his poke' — wrong pronoun for Kayle.
audit.why: Template slip. The item choice itself is right: Celestial Blessing is her only sustain and Grievous Wounds is what beats it.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed to 'her'; item line otherwise unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cross-side win rates do not reconcile: this packet reports Urgot 50.57% over 789 games, while the kayle__urgot audit recorded 54.77% for the Kayle side.
audit.why: Both sides cannot be above 50% in the same matchup. One of the two packets is sourced wrong.
audit.corrected: Left every win-rate figure untouched pending the user's decision — see questionsForUser.

edits.before: Sterak's + Cleaver makes your W-trades unloseable head-on. Kayle must dodge E forever or find a jungler — punish the first mistake with R.
edits.after: Kayle's ranged autos and Divine Judgment's untargetability blank your R here — she out-ranges the whole pattern, so take towers, not duels.

edits.before: Level 6 gives her ranged autos (Starfire Spellblade zaps) which lets her poke you while farming, but she has no burst and no escape, so keep the pressure. Freeze her off XP if you can't kill, and use your R execute on any greedy step-up. Every level you delay her is worth its weight in gold.
edits.after: Level 6 gives her ranged autos through Divine Ascent (P), letting her poke while farming, but Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1 and she has no escape once it is spent, so keep the pressure. Freeze her off XP if you can't kill, and R-execute any greedy step-up. Every level you delay is gold.

edits.before: - Kayle Divine Judgment (Invuln): matchup-defining — Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Kayle Divine Judgment: Makes an ally INVULNERABLE briefly, then bursts around them. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Kayle Divine Judgment: 160s at rank 1 — bait it and you own the next two and a half minutes. It makes her untargetable, so an R fired into it is wasted. - Kayle Celestial Blessing: a flat 15s heal, so buy Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.

edits.before: Standing still and face-tanking while W sprays — without rotating fresh legs or landing E, Kayle simply walks through the spray and out-damages you.
edits.after: Committing your R into Divine Judgment wastes a 100-second ultimate and the whole execute threat — wait the invulnerability out, then fire it and finish her.
